1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations;
__validating the bankruptcy documents to ensure compliance with specific filing requirements of each bankruptcy organization__; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations__and wherein the batch filing comprises aggregating the bankruptcy documents and filing the bankruptcy documents in a batch mode at least once per day__.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations;
__validating the data records prior to generating the proofs of claims__; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations __and wherein the proofs of claims are formatted according to the specific filing requirements of each bankruptcy court__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors __of the status of filed proofs of claims and__ that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol __and wherein the received data records are encrypted__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site __with authentication credentials required for each creditor__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day __with automatic retry functionality for failed filings__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report __specific to each creditor's filed proofs of claims__; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site __with customizable filtering options__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __and the current status of pending filings__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer __that maintains a queue of proofs of claims pending filing__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __against the specific filing requirements of the target bankruptcy organization__.
